learning_outcomes.text: Diagnose the type and scale of a change and the readiness for it
Build a compelling case for change and a guiding coalition
Design a change approach that fits the context and culture
Anticipate and work with resistance rather than against it
Sustain change through structures, incentives and reinforcement
Lead people through the emotional transition that change demands

integrative_case: A hospital network rolling out a shared electronic records system faces open resistance from senior clinicians and change fatigue from prior failed projects: assess readiness, build a credible coalition, engage the resistance, and design reinforcement so the new way of working actually sticks.

case-based decisions in the integrative case
